metadata.title: Mycroft ThesisGuard: Evidence Over Emotion
metadata.purpose: A ~3-minute Claude-branded brief on Mycroft ThesisGuard, in the house ai-explainer grammar.
metadata.audience: Practitioners and reviewers evaluating agentic finance workflows
metadata.author: Dhrumil Shah
metadata.source_status: Every figure spoken (184,138 rows; 120 tickers; 127,858/26,880/27,600 split; ROC AUC 0.5158; Brier 0.2466; moderate drift; 120 reports; 600 trace events; 0 automated decisions) is copied from the recorded Cell 25 output and the Implementation Report Outcomes table. Nothing is invented.
metadata.financial_disclaimer: Educational research and model output; not personalized financial advice or an investment recommendation.

beats.narration_text: Hi, I'm Dhrumil Shah. I built Mycroft ThesisGuard, an evidence-first review layer for investment research. In the next three minutes: what it does, what the numbers actually showed, and where it refuses to answer.
beats.new_visual_element: Claude composer cold open: the greeting, the ask typed in, the answer lines.

show.event: Serif greeting resolves above the composer.
The ask finishes typing; send button arms.
Answer lines resolve beneath the card.

props.command: My investment thesis is drifting. Before I trust any model — how do I check whether the original reason still holds?
output: Validate the data → engineer causal features → evaluate honestly
Monitor drift → review the evidence → a human decides

beats.narration_text: Investors buy for a reason. Then the facts move, and the reason quietly gets rewritten. A growth story becomes a value story. Nobody logs the change. That is thesis drift.
beats.new_visual_element: The drift sequence: the original reason silently replaced.

show.event: Headline lands, then the idea assembles one element at a time.

props.headline: Thesis Drift.
props.subtitle: the reason changes and nobody writes it down
props.kicker: THE POSITION STAYS. THE REASON QUIETLY MOVES

beats.narration_text: So this is not a buy-or-sell engine. It is a review layer. It asks one question: is your original thesis still supported by the evidence?

show.event: Headline lands, then the idea assembles one element at a time.

props.headline: Not A Predictor.
props.subtitle: decision support, never a recommendation
props.kicker: EDUCATIONAL RESEARCH OUTPUT — NOT INVESTMENT ADVICE

beats.narration_text: Start with validated market data. One hundred eighty-four thousand rows. One hundred twenty tickers. Every price checked before a model ever sees it.
beats.new_visual_element: The cleaned dataset, stated as figures from the recorded run.

show.event: Headline lands, then the idea assembles one element at a time.

props.headline: Check It First.
props.subtitle: validated before any model sees it
props.kicker: SOURCE: CELL 25 RECORDED RUN · REPORT OUTCOMES TABLE

beats.narration_text: Then features that only use what was knowable at the time. Returns. Volatility. Drawdowns. Sector-relative moves. No future data leaks backward into the inputs.
beats.new_visual_element: The feature taxonomy, bounded by the present-time rule.

show.event: Headline lands, then the idea assembles one element at a time.

props.headline: Only What Was Knowable.
props.subtitle: every input observable at prediction time
props.kicker: NO FUTURE INFORMATION IN THE FEATURES

beats.narration_text: Split it by time, never at random. Seventy percent to train, fifteen to validate, fifteen held back. Labels that cross a boundary get purged.
beats.new_visual_element: The chronological split with purged boundaries.

show.event: Headline lands, then the idea assembles one element at a time.

props.headline: Split By Time.
props.subtitle: random shuffling would leak the future
props.kicker: FIVE-DAY LABELS PURGED AT EVERY BOUNDARY

beats.narration_text: Five models compete. And the plain baseline is allowed to win, because complexity should have to earn its place.
beats.new_visual_element: Five candidates with the baseline highlighted as a legitimate winner.

show.event: Headline lands, then the idea assembles one element at a time.

props.headline: Let The Baseline Win.
props.subtitle: complexity has to beat the simple reference
props.kicker: SELECTED ON VALIDATION — THE TEST SET STAYS SEALED

beats.narration_text: Logistic regression won. Holdout ROC AUC: zero point five one five eight. Barely above a coin flip. That is the finding, not a failure. Short-horizon price direction was not reliably predictable from this data.
beats.new_visual_element: The real holdout scorecard, stated plainly.

show.event: Headline lands, then the idea assembles one element at a time.

props.headline: Barely Above Chance.
props.subtitle: and that is the result worth reporting
props.kicker: A HONEST NULL RESULT IS STILL A RESULT

beats.narration_text: Feature drift came back moderate. Don't bury a number like that. Treat uncertainty as a governance signal, not a footnote you hope nobody reads.
beats.new_visual_element: Drift surfaced to the workflow rather than hidden.

show.event: Headline lands, then the idea assembles one element at a time.

props.headline: Surface The Drift.
props.subtitle: PSI and Kolmogorov-Smirnov, reported not hidden
props.kicker: MODERATE GLOBAL DRIFT — SURFACED TO THE REVIEW QUEUE

beats.narration_text: Here's the part I care about most. The bias agent will not diagnose your psychology from a price chart. Confirmation bias, sunk-cost thinking, overconfidence: real risks, but prices are not evidence of them. So it says so, and names what is missing.
beats.new_visual_element: The bias agent declining to infer, and listing the evidence it would need.

show.event: Headline lands, then the idea assembles one element at a time.

props.headline: It Refuses To Guess.
props.subtitle: the bias assessment is withheld, on purpose
props.strongText: “No decision history. I cannot assess that.”

beats.narration_text: Then five agents review each company. Capture the thesis. Retrieve the evidence. Detect contradiction. Check for bias. And hand the decision to a human.
beats.new_visual_element: The five-stage agent chain ending at the human gate.

show.event: Headline lands, then the idea assembles one element at a time.

props.headline: Five Agents, One Gate.
props.subtitle: automation organizes; it does not decide
props.kicker: EVERY STAGE LEAVES A TRACE EVENT

beats.narration_text: One hundred twenty reports. Six hundred trace events. Zero automated decisions. The gate is the point: the system organizes evidence, it does not act.
beats.new_visual_element: The run's agent output, with the zero as the focal figure.

show.event: Headline lands, then the idea assembles one element at a time.

props.headline: Zero Automated Decisions.
props.subtitle: accountability stays with a person
props.kicker: MAINTAIN · REVISE · WATCHLIST · RETIRE — ALL HUMAN

beats.narration_text: None of this helps if you cannot look at it. So the analysis renders out: model diagnostics, calibration, feature importance, drift charts, evidence timelines, sector and risk maps. Not to decorate the result, but to make it challengeable.
beats.new_visual_element: The visualization layer framed as inspection, not decoration.

show.event: Headline lands, then the idea assembles one element at a time.

props.headline: Make It Inspectable.
props.subtitle: visuals you can argue with, not decoration
props.kicker: EVIDENCE YOU CAN CHALLENGE BEATS A NUMBER YOU CANNOT

beats.narration_text: And where evidence is missing, it stops. No thesis on file, no filings, no decision history, so it returns a placeholder, not a verdict.
beats.new_visual_element: Available market data versus the evidence that was never supplied.

show.event: Headline lands, then the idea assembles one element at a time.

beats.narration_text: So the loop is: validate the data, engineer causal features, split by time, evaluate honestly, monitor drift, review the evidence, then a person decides.
beats.new_visual_element: The whole pipeline assembled as one connected chain.

show.event: Headline lands, then the idea assembles one element at a time.

props.headline: The Whole Loop.
props.subtitle: one connected, auditable path
props.kicker: EVERY STAGE LEAVES AN ARTIFACT YOU CAN CHECK

beats.narration_text: You can run this on your own thinking today, without any of my code. Write down the claim. Write down what would change your mind. Date your evidence. And when you cannot find a source, stop, and say so.
beats.new_visual_element: The reusable four-step discipline, addressed to the viewer.

show.event: Headline lands, then the idea assembles one element at a time.

props.headline: Try This Yourself.
props.subtitle: the discipline transfers without the code
props.kicker: WRITE THE CLAIM · NAME THE DISCONFIRMER · DATE THE EVIDENCE

beats.narration_text: The strongest result here isn't a trading signal. It's a system that shows its evidence, names its uncertainty, and leaves the judgment where it belongs. Mycroft ThesisGuard.
